stairs-dead-torch.label: Out of light on a staircase
stairs-dead-torch.explanation: A Warrior with a burned-out torch stands on a down staircase at depth 30. The out-of-light routine queues the stair key (<) but falls through and reports "nothing done", so the think loop keeps queueing commands behind it — commands that would land on the new level after the stairs were taken. The corrected routine returns true.
